name: sentry
description: Read Sentry issues, events, and projects using an auth token. Load for triaging issues, reading error events, and listing projects.

content.inline:
## Sentry
Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://sentry.io/api/0` with `bearerSecret: "s/SENTRY_TOKEN"` (an auth token from sentry.io -> Settings -> Auth Tokens, scoped `project:read`, `event:read`, `org:read`). Only the secret reference goes in the request.

Common calls:
- Projects: `GET /organizations/{org_slug}/projects/`
- List issues: `GET /projects/{org_slug}/{project_slug}/issues/?query=is:unresolved&statsPeriod=14d` (URL-encode `query`)
- One issue: `GET /issues/{issue_id}/`
- Latest event: `GET /issues/{issue_id}/events/latest/`
- Update issue: `PUT /issues/{issue_id}/` body `{status: "resolved"|"ignored"}` (send via `v/ops/http/post` with `method: "PUT"`)

Rules:
- Check `status`; errors are `{detail: "..."}`. 401 = bad token; 403 = the token lacks that scope.
- Trailing slashes matter on Sentry endpoints. Results paginate via the `Link` header `rel="next"`. Self-hosted Sentry uses a different base URL - read it from the user.
